messages.en:
{07 00 00}Listen, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 14 00} today's
{ff 00 00 03}Yay Day{ff 00 00 00}, you know?

{07 16 00}It doesn't mean all that
much to me, 'cause I get
compliments all the time...
{07 14 00}But why don't you give it
a try anyway, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuule, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 14 00} täna on
{ff 00 00 03}kiidupäev{ff 00 00 00}, tead küll?

{07 16 00}Minu jaoks ei tähenda see
eriti palju, sest ma saan
komplimente kogu aeg...
{07 14 00}Aga miks sa ei proovi
ikkagi, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} you look
so nice today! {01 01 00}{07 19 00}You should
rock this look more often.{07 00 00}
Today is a day that my
town is famous for.{01 00 00 05 00} I'm
talking about {ff 00 00 03}Yay Day{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 0d 00}So,{01 00 00 05 00} why don't you try your
hand at it and compliment
me like no one ever has!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Oi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} sa näed
täna nii kena välja! {01 01 00}{07 19 00}Kanna
sellist välimust tihedamini.{07 00 00}
Täna on päev, mille poolest
mu linn on kuulus.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma
räägin {ff 00 00 03}kiidupäevast{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 0d 00}Nii et{01 00 00 05 00} proovi ja tee
mulle kompliment, nagu
keegi pole varem teinud!

{07 14 00}Kui sa minule mõtled, kas
esimene asi, millele mõtled,
on{01 00 00 05 00} „{04 21 00}”?

messages.en:
It's like the compliment
"{04 21 00}" was
made for me, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
See on nagu kompliment
„{04 21 00}” oleks minu
jaoks tehtud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I know you said
"{04 21 00}," but {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}do
you really think it fits me?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma tean, et sa ütlesid
„{04 21 00}”, aga {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}kas sa
arvad, et see sobib mulle?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 16 00}what does
{04 21 00} mean,
exactly?
{07 0b 00}Do you really think it
suits me, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 16 00}mida
{04 21 00} täpselt
tähendab?
{07 0b 00}Kas sa tõesti arvad, et see
sobib mulle, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Yeah, {01 00 00 05 00}that's me to a tee!
"{0b 03 00}{04 21 00}"! {01 01 00}{07 1b 00}It's so
not me to be so insecure.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Jah, {01 00 00 05 00}see olen täpselt mina!
„{0b 03 00}{04 21 00}”! {01 01 00}{07 1b 00}See pole minu
moodi nii ebakindel olla.

messages.en:
{07 02 00}You don't really mean that,
right?{01 00 00 0a 00}

{07 1c 00}You should really try to
compliment me seriously on
the big day!
{07 15 00}Ugh!{01 00 00 05 00} Do it right this time, 
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Sa ei mõtle seda tõsiselt,
eks?{01 00 00 0a 00}

{07 1c 00}Sa peaksid tõesti üritama
mulle sel suurel päeval
tõsiselt komplimenti teha!
{07 15 00}Öök!{01 00 00 05 00} Tee seekord õigesti,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
